probe.boundary: Independent registered tools with real Git and Python. Automatic substitutes DSH storage/session and seeds owned worktree records. Actual starts a real researcher using a deterministic model, then explicitly commits its marker before admission. No product JavaScript or deadline changes. Evaluator file gate schedules source mutation after Python starts on its independent snapshot.
